title: Sandra Banjamin
description: Sandra's extensive knowledge of family law allows her to take a considered approach to ensure a timely and cost-effective resolution.
html:
Sandra Banjamin has worked exclusively in family law both prior to and since her admission. This has allowed her to gain extensive experience having worked on various family law matters such as divorce, simple to complex property matters, parenting, international relocation, spousal maintenance, contraventions, enforcements and de facto disputes. Her experience in these areas showcases her versatility and dedication to helping her clients navigate challenging legal issues.

When it comes to family law, Sandra’s passion stems from a deep desire to serve and support people. Sandra believes that the family unit plays a crucial role in society, and being able to help families navigate their legal matters is incredibly rewarding.

Sandra understands that clients are going through a difficult time when seeking advice and so takes the time to first understand what is important to them. Clients can rest assured that through her pragmatic approach, they will receive tailored and candour advice as to what options are available to them both in and out of Court.

Sandra remains committed to being honest and compassionate with clients, helping them feel that they have her in their corner the entire way through.

Her qualifications are:

  • Bachelor of Laws (LLB) Degree
  • Masters of Applied Law (Family Law)
  • Accredited Specialist (Family Law)
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW
